context_notes: Plan 01-21 Task 1 first failed because Invoke-AbruptLossHarness.ps1 was using Invoke-AdminCommand to test protected-drive paths, which cannot see the per-user P: drive. The executor agent fixed that to use Invoke-TestCommand as LAB\uat-user1, but PSRemoting sessions still cannot see P: because mapped drives are session-specific. A scheduled-task prototype proved that P: is visible in the interactive console session. The next step is to refactor the harness to execute protected-drive operations via scheduled tasks in that session.
